name: Luxembourg
headline_status: Adults in Luxembourg may grow up to four plants and use cannabis at home, but public use is banned and there are no legal sales.
summary: Luxembourg's law of 10 July 2023 took effect on 21 July 2023, letting adults 18+ grow up to four plants per household and consume at home out of sight of minors. Public consumption is still prohibited, and carrying up to 3 g is punished with a fine rather than prosecution, while larger amounts can bring criminal charges. A planned state-regulated supply chain has not been set up. Medical cannabis is available for serious illnesses through hospital pharmacies.

adult_use_since.value: 21 July 2023 (home growing and private use only).

home_grow.value: Up to four plants per household, grown at the usual residence by adults 18+ and not visible from public space.

possession_limit.value: Up to 3 g in public draws a reduced fine (a EUR 145 warning fee is reported); more than 3 g can lead to criminal sanctions.

purchase_age.value: 18 for home growing and private consumption.

public_use.value: Public consumption remains prohibited, and using cannabis in front of a minor is an offence.

retail_sales.value: None. A state-controlled production and sales chain has been proposed as a second step but not enacted.

medical_program.value: Prescribed by Luxembourg doctors with specific training for serious, advanced or terminal illness (e.g. chronic pain, chemotherapy nausea, MS spasticity), dispensed only by hospital pharmacies; requires Luxembourg residence, health insurance or citizenship.

hemp_thc.value: Industrial hemp must contain less than 0.3% THC.

tourists.value: There is no legal way for visitors to buy cannabis, public use is banned, and the medical programme is limited to residents, insured persons or citizens.

timeline.event: Law adopted allowing home growing and private use
Home growing and private consumption become legal

faq.a: Partly. Adults can grow up to four plants and use cannabis at home, but public use is banned and there are no shops.

faq.q: Can tourists buy cannabis in Luxembourg?
faq.a: No. There are no legal sales, and public consumption is prohibited.

faq.q: What happens if you are caught with cannabis in public in Luxembourg?
faq.a: Up to 3 g is dealt with by a fine; larger amounts can lead to criminal charges.
